description: Picker-friendly scaffold for the 5th-generation gas-only RAV4 (XA50, 2019+). 2.5L A25A-FKS engine, 8-speed direct-shift automatic, TNGA-K platform. No manufacturer-specific PIDs are shipped — standard Mode 01 PIDs (RPM, MAF, fuel trims, throttle, coolant temp, O2 sensors, catalyst temps, etc.) are auto-discovered by the app regardless of profile. The scaffold exists so the vehicle picker can match a gas RAV4 cleanly (instead of falling back to `generic-obd2`) and so future Mode 21 / Mode 22 sweeps can target the engine + transmission ECUs without re-declaration. Authoring custom PIDs requires an empirical sweep on the vehicle — see community-profiles/CONTRIBUTING.md.
sources: Standard SAE J1979 Mode 01 PIDs — auto-discovered, not enumerated here

validated_against.notes: Scaffolded for an upcoming rental trip. No custom PIDs authored — the value-add over `generic-obd2` is purely the vehicle_match metadata (so the picker recommends this profile when adding a gas RAV4) and the transmission ECU declaration (so a future Mode 21/22 sweep can target 7E1 without editing the profile). Standard Mode 01 PIDs cover most of what's interesting on a non-hybrid TNGA-K vehicle. To extend this profile: run a Mode 21 sweep against engine (7E0) and transmission (7E1) during a varied-state drive, then identify any responding PIDs via byte-slice diff (see scripts/identify-mg-bytes.py).
